atomic_release_contract.executable_cache_policy: no-service-worker-executable-cache; verify-no-store-once then execute exact in-memory bytes
atomic_release_contract.upload_rule: all release files are flat at repository root; nested folders are not required for core or route visuals
atomic_release_contract.complete_runtime_preflight: every required runtime URL must return 200 before any application script executes
atomic_release_contract.visual_dependency_policy: route/decorative media can degrade or hold only that route; never block Engine boot
atomic_release_contract.stale_document_handoff: on page/manifest identity mismatch, attempt one cache-busted document navigation to deployment build+seal before HOLD; never loop
atomic_release_contract.page_identity_source: single canonical DARK_SKY_RELEASE object in index first-light bootstrap; atomic loader derives from it

release_focus: Professional-first command hierarchy, visible fleet doctrine, canonical learning pipeline, Golden Voyage assurance, and cinematic presentation as an optional second view
release_note: 8.5.0 Command Hardening promotes Professional View to the operational default for Captain and Admiral trial command, retains Cinematic View as optional presentation, establishes a machine-readable Fleet Doctrine Registry and unified Fleet Learning pipeline, defines six Golden UI Voyages, and adds a clear Engine → Captain → Admiral command model without disturbing vessel isolation, owner/customer surfaces, GlyphForge, or approved-artifact contracts.
